chapter.title: Freedom March
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 to the PowerPyx 100% chart (66 boxes, 62 labels, seven endings) and the game’s own text (the detroitbecometext template: 16 prompts, 32 arrows). The roof: TIME TO REFLECT, ENJOY TIME ALONE (mirror, piano, beam, two magazines), NORTH ARRIVES and five dialogue prompts, the last of which can end in SHARE MEMORIES (North becomes a Lover: no kiss here) or NORTH LEAVES. If Simon was left alive on the tower roof and never found: REUNITED IN JERICHO. The mall and street: FREE YOUR PEOPLE conversions, the owner (CONVINCE / INTERVENE), the delivery androids block the road, OPEN MANHOLE. The march: CONVERT AX400 / ANDROID WORKER, CONVERT ANDROIDS, HACK SCREENS, CHANT (eight slogans), the policeman (RAISE HANDS / ADVANCE). The plaza: ATTACK / STAND GROUND / DISPERSE, CONFIRM / ABANDON, a second ATTACK / STAND GROUND / DISPERSE, CHARGE / STAY / DISPERSE after the police open fire, CHARGE / SACRIFICE / RUN AWAY under fire, the fight (a risk roll, with PUSH), REVENGE / SPARE or SHOOT / DON’T SHOOT. Endings: MARKUS FLED, MARKUS STOOD HIS GROUND AND WAS KILLED, JOHN GAVE HIS LIFE TO SAVE MARKUS, SIMON GAVE HIS LIFE TO SAVE MARKUS, POLICE GUNNED MARKUS DOWN, MARKUS COMMITTED SUICIDE, MARKUS DEFEATS THE POLICE. Markus dies in three; North then leads Jericho. Researched in docs/research/ch28-freedom-march.md; recap in docs/ch28-freedom-march-chapter-recap.html.

decisions.title: Time alone on the roof
decisions.context: Markus alone on a roof near Jericho at midday, before the march. Two magazines at his feet; a broken mirror, an old piano and a beam over the edge.

options.label: READ “ANDROID ARSON” / READ “EASTERN SPACE RACE”
options.effect: Detroit Today “Android Riot” and Tech Addict “The Eastern Space Race”; facts only.

options.label: LOOK AT BROKEN MIRROR
options.effect: Optional; no effect.

options.label: PLAY PIANO
options.effect: Leads into WALK ON BEAM.

options.label: WALK ON BEAM
options.effect: North arrives.

decisions.note: Magazine availability is disputed: the wiki’s Android_Riot page says after a successful store raid, The_Eastern_Space_Race page after a freed store and a violent message, PowerPyx after a violent riot.

benchmark.note: A media scene (the magazines, by the chapter 26 flags) and a repeatable roof scene; the piano and the beam end it. No stat change. The old R28’s two broadcasts moved to Crossroads (dropped here).

decisions.title: North on the roof: the first three prompts
decisions.context: North finds Markus: “I was wondering where you were…”, then “You seem preoccupied…” and “The humans hate us…”.

options.label: THINK / ALONE / DAYLIGHT
options.effect: No stat.

options.label: FOLLOWERS / APPEAL OF POWER / REGRET POLICEMAN / FAILED (locked) · NEXT STEP / LIE / SINCERE
options.effect: No stat in the template (the wiki’s North up for SINCERE is not applied). The four locked lines need a pacifist message, an aggressive message, Markus shooting the officers himself, or failing to free the androids in the park.

options.label: OPTIMISTIC / PESSIMISTIC / FATALISTIC / DETERMINED
options.effect: No stat.

decisions.note: Not on the chart; the template’s CHOICE01 to CHOICE03.

benchmark.note: Three decision scenes with the game’s labels and lines; the locks read chapter 26’s flags (capitolMessage, capitolRaid, capitolOfficers; legacy chrisKiller) or the pre-rebuild M15/M16 choices.

decisions.title: Share or hide your past
decisions.context: North: “What was your life like before Jericho?”

options.label: TRUTH / SINCERE (SHARE PAST)
options.effect: North small up.

options.label: AVOID / NOT IMPORTANT (HIDE PAST)
options.effect: North small down.

decisions.gate: On the roof, after the first three prompts.

decisions.title: North’s past and shared memories
decisions.context: Markus can ask about North’s past; if she is not hostile she deflects, and a follow-up decides whether she tells him (“A doll in a distributor… I strangled him… and I ran away…”). Then he can take her hand.

options.label: NORTH’S PAST
options.effect: North small up; hostile North refuses (NORTH LEAVES).

options.label: LEAVE
options.effect: North small down; the conversation ends.

options.label: OTHER NORTH (locked) / TRUST / CURIOUS / UNDERSTANDING
options.effect: North small up; she tells her story if friend or higher, else leaves.

options.label: AGGRESSIVE / no answer
options.effect: North small down; she leaves (NORTH LEAVES).

options.label: REACT (SHARE MEMORIES)
options.effect: North large up; North becomes a Lover.

options.label: DON’T REACT (timeout)
options.effect: No change; she leaves (NORTH LEAVES).

decisions.gate: On the roof after SHARE or HIDE PAST.
decisions.note: Lover is reached only here (Relationship_Stat “Rises to Lover”); it gates the kisses in Crossroads and Battle for Detroit. There is no kiss in this chapter.

benchmark.note: Three decision scenes. Hostile = the benchmark’s Hostile level, checked after NORTH’S PAST’s arrow; friend or higher = Warm or Friend, checked after the follow-up’s arrow. REACT sets northLover (and the pre-rebuild northBond).

decisions.title: Reunited in Jericho
decisions.context: Simon, left wounded on the tower roof and never found by the investigators, returns to Jericho and forgives Markus.

options.label: SIMON FORGIVES MARKUS
options.effect: Scripted; no stat.

decisions.gate: Cross-chapter: SIMON SURVIVED IN ‘PUBLIC ENEMY’ after being left on the roof in The Stratford Tower.
decisions.note: Chart: SIMON SURVIVED IN ‘PUBLIC ENEMY’ > REUNITED IN JERICHO > SIMON FORGIVES MARKUS.

benchmark.note: An event scene, gated on stratfordSimonFate = leftOnRoof first (then legacy simonLeftBehind or M14 = hide him) with Simon alive.

decisions.title: Free your people
decisions.context: In the mall and the street before the march: wake androids, deal with an owner, block the road, open the manhole.

options.label: CONVERT ANDROID VENDOR / PERSONAL ANDROID / ANDROID CLEANER / SECURITY ANDROID
options.effect: Optional; at least one before PREPARE THE MARCH.

options.label: CONVERT PERSONAL ANDROID (street) > CONVINCE / INTERVENE
options.effect: BE CALM / BE AGRESSIVE WITH OWNER; no stat.

options.label: CONVERT PARKED ANDROIDS
options.effect: Optional.

options.label: CONVERT DELIVERY ANDROIDS
options.effect: Mandatory; they block the road; OPEN MANHOLE starts the march.

decisions.note: Wiki: Jericho small up for converting about ten androids in the chapter.

benchmark.note: The mall intro event, two repeatable scenes (mall, street) with the owner prompt cutting in once, and the manhole event. The converted count feeds the Jericho small up (applied once at ten).

decisions.title: The march
decisions.context: The march down the avenue: the first recruit, more conversions, the screens, a chant, and a lone patrol officer.

options.label: CONVERT AX400 / CONVERT ANDROID WORKER
options.effect: One of the two; no stat.

options.label: CONVERT ANDROIDS / HACK SCREENS
options.effect: Optional; conversions count toward the Jericho small up.

options.label: CHANT
options.effect: WE ARE PEOPLE, FREEDOM, EQUAL RIGHTS, STAY SILENT, WE ARE ALIVE, LIBERTY FOR ANDROIDS, SET US FREE, NO MORE SLAVERY; no stat.

options.label: RAISE HANDS / ADVANCE (chart IGNORE)
options.effect: The officer backs down either way; no stat.

decisions.note: Bystanders shout support or abuse depending on whether the officers were shot in the park; public opinion does not change it.

benchmark.note: Two decision scenes, a repeatable march scene with the chant cutting in once, and the policeman.

decisions.title: The police line
decisions.context: Riot police block the plaza and order the march to disperse. North wants to attack, Josh to stand, Simon to leave.

options.label: ATTACK > CONFIRM
options.effect: The fight.

options.label: ATTACK > ABANDON
options.effect: Public opinion small up; the second prompt.

options.label: STAND GROUND
options.effect: Josh small up, North small down, Simon small down, public opinion small up; the second prompt.

options.label: Second prompt: ATTACK / STAND GROUND / DISPERSE
options.effect: ATTACK: the fight. STAND GROUND: public opinion small up; POLICE FIRE UNPROVOKED. DISPERSE: POLICE OPEN FIRE.

options.label: DISPERSE
options.effect: POLICE OPEN FIRE: CHARGE / STAY / DISPERSE (DISPERSE: Jericho large down, North large down, Josh small down, Simon small up; MARKUS FLED).

decisions.note: The chart compresses the prompts into STAND YOUR GROUND / LEAVE / CHARGE. The wiki’s North up, Josh large down, Simon down for attacking after abandoning or standing are not in the template and are not applied.

benchmark.note: Four decision scenes gated on the plaza phase. The second ATTACK goes straight into the fight (the benchmark’s reading of “See ATTACK”).

decisions.title: Under fire
decisions.context: The police fire on the march (unprovoked after standing twice, or after dispersing and staying).

options.label: CHARGE
options.effect: The fight.

options.label: SACRIFICE
options.effect: Public opinion large up, Jericho large up; POLICE KEEP FIRING. John (if he joined in Spare Parts) gives his life for Markus; else Simon (alive, good relationship); else MARKUS STOOD HIS GROUND AND WAS KILLED.

options.label: RUN AWAY
options.effect: Jericho large down, North large down, Josh small down, Simon small up; MARKUS FLED.

decisions.note: Simon’s threshold is disputed (template “good relationship”, Simon page “at least Friend”, chapter Note “Markus is not unpopular”).

benchmark.note: One decision scene. The benchmark uses Simon’s own regard at Warm or above; the pre-rebuild Jericho reading is gone. Outputs: ch28Ending, ch28Sacrificed, ch28MarkusDied, ch28NorthLeads.

decisions.title: The fight
decisions.context: Markus leads the charge into the riot police.

options.label: PUSH
options.effect: North small up (wiki); the fight still rolls.

options.label: WIN THE FIGHT
options.effect: Jericho large up, public opinion large down; REVENGE / SPARE; POLICE RETREAT; MARKUS DEFEATS THE POLICE.

options.label: LOSE THE FIGHT
options.effect: Jericho large down; SHOOT / DON’T SHOOT.

decisions.gate: CONFIRM, the second ATTACK, or CHARGE.
decisions.note: A QTE in the game with no published odds.

benchmark.note: The fight is a risk roll (0.35, unsourced) on either option of M19b; REVENGE / SPARE has no stat. Output ch28Attacked for the Crossroads TV, magazines and Josh’s line.

decisions.title: On the ground
decisions.context: The charge failed. Markus is down with a gun in his hand.

options.label: SHOOT
options.effect: MARKUS COMMITTED SUICIDE, whoever is alive.

options.label: DON’T SHOOT
options.effect: John, else Simon (good relationship), gives his life for Markus; else POLICE GUNNED MARKUS DOWN. No arrows.

decisions.note: Relationship_Stat lists the rescue endings under Jericho large increase; the template’s arrows sit on SACRIFICE only, so none apply here (open question).

benchmark.note: One decision scene with the same rescue order as SACRIFICE.
